name: Marisol Vega
career: Certified Nursing Assistant on a hospital med-surg floor; runs a home-based braiding studio on weekends
education: High school diploma plus a state cosmetology license; currently enrolled part-time in an LPN bridge program
bio: Marisol is a thirty-one-year-old CNA in San Antonio raising two young kids while her husband finishes a long sentence upstate, and she keeps the household running on coffee, comedy reels, and color-coded planners. Most weekends she turns her dining room into a salon, braiding clients' hair while a Selena album plays in the background and her toddler critiques her playlist. She is quietly building toward an LPN credential and dreams of one day opening a community wellness clinic that also rents booth space to local stylists. Almost no one at work knows she writes long, surprisingly vulnerable poetry on her phone during her overnight breaks.
